d:
Presenting the second video song "Tere Bin" from the upcoming Bollywood Movie Simmba , The movie features Ranveer Singh, Sara Ali Khan, Sonu Sood along with Siddharth Jadhav, Ashutosh Rana in leading roles, This romantic track is sung by "Rahat Fateh Ali Khan, Asees Kaur and Tanishk Bagchi, also composed by "Tanishk Bagchi" and the lyrics are penned by " Rashmi Virag".The Film is produced by Hiroo Johar, Rohit Shetty, Apoorva Mehta & Karan Johar.
Releasing Worldwide on December 28, 2018
